svg.title: freeing_moves: turning shared space into dependencies
svg.desc: GarageOccupancyChecker remembers which events used each pose. A later move through a pose depends on every earlier event whose footprint collides there.
svg.metadata: ["Start: freeing_moves (a GarageOccupancyChecker) is empty. T21 sits in bay B21, T15 on P15, T17 on P17, T20 on P20.", "e0, the BayTransition TO_RETRIEVE, is processed: ApplyTransitionToFreeingMoves() records e0 as an occupant of the bay pose B21. The dashed arrow previews the next event, e1 (T21 -> P23).", "e1 (TrayMove T21 -> P23) is processed: its source pose B21 gets e1 as a second occupant. T21 now stands on P23 in working_state.", "Every pose on e1's path (P23, W22, W41, ...) is recorded too, so later moves that cross that path will wait for e1. The dashed arrow previews the blocker move e4 (T15 -> P19), emitted next.", "While e2 (T17 -> B21) resolves its blockers, the blocker move e4 (T15 -> P19) is emitted and its source pose P15 is recorded with e4.", "Now e2's path is checked pose by pose. GetBlockers(P15) returns e4, because T15's old footprint collides with T17's: edge e4 -> e2.", "At the destination B21, GetBlockers returns e1, which took T21 out of the bay: edge e1 -> e2.", "B21 also returns e0, the bay transition registered there: edge e0 -> e2. All three edges are AddDependency() calls on the event DAG.", "Finally e2 is applied (T17 now stands in B21 in working_state) and adds itself as an occupant of every pose it uses, so later moves through P17, P15, ..., B21 will depend on e2."]
